bindingUserDecision.qualityPolicy: Production-release visual quality is fixed from the first Golden Master; scope is limited to S02 instead of lowering fidelity.
bindingUserDecision.experiencePromise: Within five seconds, a first-time player understands that four cats auto-battle enemies, climb an unbounded tower, gain rewards, and become stronger with shop and delivery support.
bindingUserDecision.imagePolicy: Generated full-screen art is a design target only. Runtime may not use a flattened full-screen image, transparent overlay controls, or simple crop-and-place reconstruction.
bindingUserDecision.textPolicy: Japanese copy, numbers, HP, floor, currencies and labels are exact text layers and are not baked into generated artwork.
bindingUserDecision.responsivePolicy: Background, characters, enemies and effects preserve aspect ratio; UI reflows by viewport and safe area rather than uniformly scaling a complete screen.
bindingUserDecision.userDecisionBoundary: Only final preference between production-credible alternatives and physical-iPhone-only evidence may be returned to the user.
